cards.text: Friend, John is writing down what he sees in a vision, to send to the churches (Revelation 1:11). He's just watched a rider called Faithful and True ride out of heaven on a white horse (Revelation 19:11). Now John sees an angel coming down from heaven, holding the key to the Abyss and a great chain.

cards.question: The angel seizes the dragon, that ancient serpent. John gives the dragon two more names. What are they?

cards.text: Then the angel binds him for a thousand years. FOUR names this guy has, friend, and I've only got two: Papa, and the Dorin my old family carved on my handle.

cards.question: The angel has the dragon bound with a great chain. Where does the angel throw him?

cards.text: The angel shuts the Abyss and seals it over him. I spent years shut in a junk drawer, friend, but at least mine popped open every time somebody needed TAPE.

cards.question: The Abyss is sealed over the dragon so that he cannot ___ the nations until the thousand years are complete.
Once the thousand years are complete, the dragon stays sealed in the Abyss for good.

cards.text: Then John sees thrones, and those seated on them have been given authority to judge. He also sees the souls of people who had been beheaded.

cards.question: John sees the souls of people beheaded for their testimony of ___ and for the word of God.

cards.text: He also sees those who had not worshiped the beast or taken its mark. That's the beast John saw rise out of the sea earlier in his vision (Revelation 13:1).

cards.question: What happens to those beheaded souls and the ones who refused the beast?

answers.text: They come to life and reign with Christ
They rest under the altar a while longer
They stand guard over the sealed Abyss

cards.text: And the rest of the dead? John says they don't come back to life until the thousand years are complete.

cards.question: Some come to life and reign with Christ, while the rest of the dead wait. John calls this the first ___.

cards.text: Then John says, "Blessed and holy are those who share in the first resurrection!" Blessed AND holy, friend. Both at once.

cards.question: John says the second death has no power over those who share in the first resurrection.
What will those who share in the first resurrection be as they reign with Christ?

answers.text: Priests of God and of Christ
Guards at the gates of the city

cards.text: When the thousand years are complete, Satan will be released from his prison. A THOUSAND years locked up, friend, and he'll go right back to deceiving the nations in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog.

cards.question: Satan will deceive the nations of Gog and Magog. What will he gather them for?

cards.text: John says their number is like the sand of the seashore. And I thought the junk drawer I spent years in was CROWDED.
That army marches across the broad expanse of the earth and surrounds the camp of the saints and the beloved city.

cards.question: Satan's army surrounds the camp of the saints and the beloved city. Then what happens to that army?

answers.text: Fire comes down from heaven and consumes them
The saints march out and drive them away
They turn around and run back home

cards.text: Then the devil who deceived them is thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur. The beast and the false prophet, who did signs for the beast (Revelation 19:20), had already been thrown in there.

cards.question: John says the devil, the beast and the false prophet will be tormented there for a thousand years and then it ends.

cards.text: Then John sees a great white throne and the One seated on it. And something flees from His presence.

cards.question: What flees from the presence of the One seated on the great white throne?

cards.text: John sees the dead, great and small, standing before the throne. Books are opened, and one of them is the Book of Life.

cards.question: The dead standing before the throne are judged according to their ___, as recorded in the books.

cards.text: Then John sees where those dead come from. The sea gives up its dead.

cards.question: Along with the sea, Death and Hades also give up their dead.

cards.text: Then Death and Hades themselves are thrown into the lake of fire.

cards.question: John calls the lake of fire the second death.
At the great white throne, who is thrown into the lake of fire?

answers.text: Anyone not written in the Book of Life
Anyone who stood before the throne
Anyone who had been great on the earth
